::: {#sol-next-id}

1. The first call changes `count` from 0 to 1 and returns 1.
   The second call changes `count` from 1 to 2 and returns 2.
2. No.
   A function with no arguments has exactly one value,
   but `next_id()` returned 1 and then 2.
   What it returns depends on the variable `count`,
   which is not an argument and which each call changes.

:::
